steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing. Wait 3 minutes after unplugging before measuring SMPS terminals (160 Vdc may remain). R-134a sealed-system precautions apply.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Enter LCD check
steps.body: Simultaneously press Express Freezer + Freezer temp adjust ~1 s — all LCD/LED graphics and backlight turn on.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Simultaneously press Express Freezer + Freezer temp adjust ~1 s — all LCD/LED graphics and backlight turn on.

steps.title: All segments illuminate?
steps.body: Every LCD/LED graphic region (C–G) should turn on. Hidden faults: R2, OptiChill, water tank, ice maker, ambient (Better1).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Every LCD/LED graphic region (C–G) should turn on. Hidden faults: R2, OptiChill, water tank, ice maker, ambient (Better1).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Segment(s) failed — note which region (C–G) stayed off.

steps.title: Segment or sensor fault
steps.oemOutcome: Follow LCD check map: region C=R2/micom comm, D=OptiChill/water tank, E=ice sensor, F=ice unit, G=ambient.

steps.title: LCD check passed
steps.oemOutcome: All display segments and backlight verified.
